definitions.meaningful_reversal: Adjacent omega signs opposite and each |omega| >=0.05 rad/s.
definitions.small_reversal: Adjacent omega signs opposite and each |omega| >=0.005 rad/s; catches residual chatter below the main threshold.
definitions.deltaomega_rms: RMS of changes between consecutive applied angular commands; excludes initial zero-to-command.
definitions.low_speed: |v|<0.01 m/s; episode needs >=0.5s. Total low-speed seconds counts individual steps too.
definitions.far_goal: L1 distance to A* goal cell center [1.81875,0.09375] >0.10m, using precontrol pose.
definitions.common_window: From t=0 through min(baseline steps,new steps) for each matched seed.
definitions.covariance: Exact same-source nonlinear step evaluated with optimized first input; no new solves.
definitions.success_caveat: Stuck criterion stops after <=3cm net displacement over4s; does not establish permanent deadlock.
